jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(A) inventory: Enosburgh-Richford Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Franklin Northeast Supervisory Union (member towns Enosburgh and Richford).

sources.note: Enosburgh-Richford UUSD board members page (Franklin Northeast SU, official): six directors -- Sara Hurtubise (Chair, Richford, term ends 2027), Rachael Tatro (Clerk, Enosburgh, 2027), Joshua Muir (Enosburgh, 2028), Devin Lumbra (Richford, 2028), Akua Smith (Vice Chair, Enosburgh, 2029), Gabrielle Elwood (Richford, 2029). All six are named across the September 8 and October 13, 2026 minutes. Seats are residency-allocated (Enosburgh 3 / Richford 3) but elected by the whole district (modified at-large; State Board default articles Art. 10(A) 'Hybrid Model', expanded 4 to 6 seats in 2019 -- the 2019 amendment tally itself was not located in an official document). Lumbra's current membership is ELECTED: he was appointed March 11, 2025 to a vacant Richford seat and then elected March 3, 2026 to its remaining two years.

Mort Greenwood chaired the Enosburgh-Richford board through the February 17, 2026 meeting and signed the March 2026 warning as Chair; he is absent from the March 10, 2026 reorganization minutes and the current roster (his Richford seat passed to Gabrielle Elwood at the March 3, 2026 election). Whether he stood for re-election is not stated in any fetched source. His membership is ended in 2026. (Some minutes spell his first name 'Morton'; the signed warnings read Mort.)
